name: quickbite
description: QuickBite — food delivery (Expo client + web dashboard + Supabase)

scripts.functions:serve: supabase functions serve notify-new-order send-order-sms create-payment-intent stripe-webhook directions --no-verify-jwt
scripts.functions:deploy: supabase functions deploy notify-new-order && supabase functions deploy send-order-sms && supabase functions deploy create-payment-intent && supabase functions deploy stripe-webhook && supabase functions deploy directions && supabase functions deploy rio
scripts.types:client: supabase gen types typescript --project-id motqehtswgjbbvoazarh --schema public > apps/client/src/types/database.ts
scripts.types:manager: supabase gen types typescript --project-id motqehtswgjbbvoazarh --schema public > apps/manager/src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
scripts.types:gen: npm run types:client && npm run types:manager
scripts.ml:cancel-risk: bash -c 'if [ -x .venv-ml/bin/python ]; then exec .venv-ml/bin/python scripts/cancel_risk.py; else exec python3 scripts/cancel_risk.py; fi'
scripts.test: npm run check:secrets && npm run test:unit && npm run test:edge && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=@quickbite/shared && npm run test --workspace=client && npm run test --workspace=dashboard
